subject: Triad Nexus + Mate Labs co-sell demo — consolidate windows & runbook
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@triadnexus.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Triad Nexus + Mate Labs co-sell demo — proposal to consolidate windows & runbook

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the coordination so far. Quick ask: Mate Labs and Triad Nexus currently have two adjacent co-sell windows next week (Tue 10/5 09:00 PT and Tue 10/5 10:30 PT). To reduce overhead for the AWS SI and our mutual customers, would Redwood be open to consolidating into a single 75-minute session that covers both customer audiences with a short break?

Proposed benefits:
- Single runbook, single recording for marketplace listing
- Reduced ops overhead for AWS and SI team
- Easier for product to demo the end-to-end pipeline once

If yes, can we:
- Lock a single slot (preferably 10:00–11:15 PT)
- Assign roles (host, demo lead, Q&A moderator, recording owner)
- Pre-fill a runbook and share a rehearsal time (30 min)

Attaching a rough runbook outline and the current calendar slots for reference. AWS SI is on board in principle but they asked us to confirm run-time and host rotation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

— Raj
Head of Partnerships, Triad Nexus

Attachments: runbook-outline-v0.2.pdf, proposed-calendar.ics

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj@triadnexus.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Triad Nexus + Mate Labs co-sell demo — proposal to consolidate windows & runbook

Raj —

Totally makes sense and thanks for the clear ask. We can consolidate into a single session; 10:00–11:15 PT is workable from our side with one ask below.

Quick proposal (draft):
- Slot: Tue 10/5, 10:15–11:30 PT (give a 15-min buffer before/after)
- Host rotation: Redwood (Vanessa) opens; Triad Nexus (Raj) runs partner positioning; Mate Labs (Sara) does technical validation; AWS SI demo segment at ~00:35–00:55 into the run.
- Rehearsal: Mon 10/4, 09:00–09:30 PT (recorded)
- Runbook link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/merged-runbook-draft (I populated a starter agenda and role checklist)

Action items for everyone: 
- Raj/Sara: confirm final attendee list + any demo accounts needed by EOD Thu 9/30
- Vanessa/Karthik (Redwood): we will prep the live demo environment and a fallback recording
- AWS SI: confirm whether they need a dry run or prefer a brief pre-call with product owners

I've attached a consolidated runbook draft (merged-runbook-draft.docx) — please review, edit inline, and add any tech notes. If that slot doesn't work for AWS SI, flag with an alternate hour and we'll pivot.

Cheers,
Grace
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: merged-runbook-draft.docx

We prefer a single session (agreed on the benefits). If Redwood can absorb the later start, we'll confirm attendees and any account credentials by EOD Thu.

All —

11:15–12:30 PT works for Redwood. I can host the session and take the first 20 minutes for product framing + marketplace listing Qs. We'll keep the live demo around the middle of the session and reserve 15 minutes at the end for customer Q&A.

Vanessa (cc Karthik) — will you own the recording and the post-demo artifact (short clip + landing page copy)? If yes, I'll add you as the recording owner in the runbook.

I'll update the calendar and lock the invite once Raj/Sara confirm final attendees.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz

Perfect — locking 11:15–12:30 PT for Tue 10/5. 

Final checklist before I send the calendar: 
- Raj/Sara: final attendee list + any demo accounts by EOD Thu 9/30
- Vanessa: recording owner + landing copy (assign to you in runbook)
- Karthik: confirm fallback variant model we'll demo and whether we should stage a quantized build for lower-latency demo (flagged in runbook)
- AWS SI: confirm we'll still do a 10-minute pre-call 30 minutes before the session for a quick connectivity check

I'll update the runbook doc and push the calendar invite with the merged agenda + attachments (merged-runbook-draft.docx, runbook-outline-v0.2.pdf, proposed-calendar.ics). If anything changes before Thu EOD, post here and I'll adjust.

Thanks everyone — looking forward.
